title: China Uses Biden-Xi Summit to Warn Trump
description: Xi's remarks come after Trump tapped Taiwan supporters Marco Rubio and Mike Waltz for top spots in his administration.

title: A political dynasty in the making: Chiang Kai-shek’s great-grandson a rising star in Taiwan
description: The elder Chiang Kai-shek was still in charge of Taiwan in 1970 when then-prime minister Pierre Trudeau cut off Canada’s formal diplomatic relations with the island and established ties with the People’s Republic of China

title: As Beijing threatens, Taiwan looks nervously at Trump
description: The president-elect pressed Taiwan during his campaign to spend significantly more to defend against the growing threat of attack by China. Some in Taiwan say it can’t afford to spend what Donald Trump demands.

title: Xi Warns Biden Not To Cross 'Red Line' By Supporting Taiwan As China Prepares For Trump
description: Xi Jinping listed Taiwan, human rights and China's development interests as key red lines in his conversation with Biden.

title: Xi Jinping Pledges Stability with Trump's Incoming Administration
description: Chinese President Xi Jinping expressed readiness to work with the incoming U.S. administration under Donald Trump, aiming for a stable China-U.S. relationship. In a meeting with outgoing President Joe Biden, both leaders discussed major issues, including trade tensions, Taiwan, and regional stability concerns.

title: Xi and Biden: Navigating the Perils of Transition
description: Chinese President Xi Jinping and outgoing U.S. Vice President Joe Biden discussed strengthening U.S.-China relations amidst global tensions during a meeting at the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation forum. Key issues included trade, Taiwan, North Korea, and cyber security, highlighting ongoing challenges and strategic differences between the two nations.

title: Taiwan, democracy, development are China's 'red lines,' Xi tells Biden
description: Xi warned the United States not to get involved in bilateral disputes over islands and reefs in the South China Sea, according to state media Xinhua

title: Taiwan's APEC representative says no handshake or dialogue with China's Xi, only wave
description: The forum is one of the few international meetings both Taiwan and China take part in

title: Tensions Simmer at APEC: Taiwan's Diplomatic Dance
description: At the APEC forum in Lima, Taiwan's Lin Hsin-i greeted China's President Xi Jinping with a mere wave. This gesture underscores ongoing tensions between Taiwan, listed as 'Chinese Taipei', and China, which claims the island as its territory. The forum remains one of the few platforms for interaction between the two.

title: Diplomatic Waves: Taiwan's Subtle APEC Encounter
description: At the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit in Lima, Taiwan's representative Lin Hsin-i greeted China's President Xi Jinping with a wave but had no further interaction. This highlights tensions between Taipei and Beijing, as Taiwan's government stands firm against China's sovereignty claims.
